description: Where a store shows up in search for the words its own homepage uses (homepage title, top categories and top products, with the brand and its own product-line names removed so they are searches any shopper could type), checked weekly. Works for your own store and for any competitor you track. Shows the position on every search, which tracked competitors and other sites are ahead, and moves in and out of the top 10 over the last 90 days. The order is a blend of several search engines (Google CSE, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, Brave, as they answered), searched with no country set: it is not a Google rank.

domain.description: One of your own stores or a competitor you track, e.g. mystore.com. Omit for your own store with the latest check.

only_behind.description: true = only searches where a tracked competitor is ahead of you or you are not in the top 20.

query_source.description: Only searches that come from your homepage_title, a top category, or a top product. Omit for all.

name: get_search_ranking
title: Search ranking
